description: Fairwai is a meeting intelligence platform that transcribes and analyzes your calls, video meetings, and in-person conversations. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your meeting data: search past meetings semantically or by keyword, fetch the AI-generated report of any meeting (decisions, key points, action items), read raw transcripts, and list upcoming calendar events — all scoped to the meetings you have attended or been granted team access to.
